title: Climate Change Adaptation Plan 2025-2035 with the Action Plan 2025-2027
organization: Ministry of Ecology, Sustainable Development, and Northern Region Development of Montenegro
temporal_coverage: National adaptation plan for 2025-2035; cited observed events and social data are dated in the report, while its risk assessment also discusses projected hazards.
methodology: Plan includes sector vulnerability, gender and capacity assessments.
limitations: Local capacity findings are assessment conclusions.

title: Montenegro National Drought Plan
organization: Ministry of Sustainable Development and Tourism, Government of Montenegro, with UNCCD support
temporal_coverage: Plan dated November 2020; it describes then-current monitoring and drought-management arrangements and summarizes earlier events and proposed actions.
methodology: National working group plan synthesizes sector impacts, drought monitoring, risk assessment and preparedness measures.
limitations: Institutional status and statistics are historical to the 2020 plan; recommendations are not verified implementation.

title: Country Climate and Development Report: Western Balkans 6. Montenegro Country Compendium
temporal_coverage: Country compendium dated October 2024; combines historical event data, institutional assessment and modeled climate-risk scenarios.
methodology: Uses hazard-risk modeling, a Climate Change Institutional Assessment, and social-protection analysis.
limitations: Model results are scenario-dependent; recommendations describe proposed rather than delivered reforms.

title: Common Country Analysis Update 2023: Montenegro
organization: United Nations Country Team in Montenegro
temporal_coverage: Light-touch update; the report states its evidence and data are current as of 30 November 2023 and describes 2022-2023 events.
methodology: UN country analysis update synthesizes national and international data across development priorities.
limitations: Climate observations are historical; the update does not establish a climate-conflict causal relationship.
